name: Google Drive
author: VanillaGreen
description: Keep folders on this computer in step with Google Drive. VGS copies both ways every hour and never deletes a file.

requirements.purpose: Runs the sync and reads its status
Copies the files to and from Google Drive
Lets only one sync of a folder pair run at a time
Runs the sync every hour while you are logged in
Reads the Google Drive keys from the keyring
Tells you when the Google Drive sync needs you
Reads the name of the Google account you sign in with
Asks the setup questions in the setup window
Opens the Google sign-in page and the folders to review

reset-pairs.title: Start the folder pair list again

setupGuide.title: Google Drive needs keys from your own Google account
setupGuide.text: It is free and takes about 5 minutes in Google Cloud.

sync.label: Google Drive sync
sync.info: VGS copies each folder pair both ways. Newer files win, and VGS never deletes a file. It keeps an older copy on this computer for 30 days, so old copies do not fill your disk. Google Drive keeps an older copy in the file's version history for 30 days, up to 100 versions: Google sets that limit. To keep a version longer, open the version history in Google Drive and select Keep forever.

action.label: Start the folder pair list again

account.label: Account
account.hint: Sign out stops the sync. Your files stay here and in Google Drive.

pairs.label: Folder pairs
pairs.hint: Each pair keeps one Google Drive folder and one folder on this computer the same. Remove stops the sync of a pair and deletes no file.

cloudKeys.label: Google Cloud keys
cloudKeys.hint: Paste the two keys of your Google Cloud client. VGS keeps them in your keyring.
cloudKeys.info: Google Drive signs in through a client you make in your own Google Cloud account. The client has two keys, a Client ID and a Client secret. The guide at the top of this tab shows each step to make them.

connection.label: Sign in to Google
connection.hint: Google opens in your browser and asks you to allow access to Google Drive
connection.info: Sign in lets VGS read and change the files in your Google Drive. It copies only your folder pairs and never deletes a file. Google says it has not verified the app. It is your own app, so select Advanced, then Go to VGS.

firstPair.label: First folder pair
firstPair.hint: Choose the first folders to keep on this computer and in Google Drive. The hourly sync turns on with them.
